privacy.metaDescription: How TrackDraw handles your information, content, connected apps and service usage.
privacy.effectiveDate: Effective October 21, 2026. This policy explains what information TrackDraw uses, why, how long it is kept and the choices you have.
privacy.s1Body: Dutch Drone Squad operates trackdraw.app. This policy covers information processed by the hosted TrackDraw service, including accounts, saved content, sharing and connected apps.
privacy.s2Intro: TrackDraw processes the following categories of information:
privacy.s2Item1: Account and membership information — names, email addresses, sign-in records, account activity, security settings and access roles.
privacy.s2Item2: Project information — track designs, obstacle configurations, names, other content you save and the dates it was created or changed.
privacy.s2Item3: Sharing and access information — visibility settings, invitations, recipient email addresses, delivery and acceptance status, shared links, published content and preview images.
privacy.s2Item4: Integration information — connection and credential records, permissions you grant, access expiry and revocation, and records needed to carry out requests reliably.
privacy.s2Item5: Operational information — security and audit records, authentication events, errors and short-lived per-IP counters used to limit authentication requests.
privacy.s2Item6: Product analytics — limited records of how people reach and use TrackDraw, whether actions succeed and the technical context needed to improve reliability and language support. Records may include timestamps, a short-lived browser-session identifier, an account, project or share reference, and predefined action categories or status codes. Separate summaries cover product use, language demand, coarse country and referring-website hostnames, with minimum reporting thresholds for referring websites. Analytics exclude free-form content, track content, filenames, referring paths or queries, IP addresses, precise location, user-agent strings, device fingerprints, exception messages and request bodies.
privacy.s3Body: TrackDraw uses information to provide the features you choose, secure the service, manage accounts and send essential service notices. TrackDraw uses limited analytics to improve reliability and usability, based on TrackDraw’s legitimate interest in operating and improving TrackDraw. Access is limited to the relevant purpose, and records for different purposes are kept separate. TrackDraw does not use this information for advertising or cross-site profiling.
privacy.s4Body: Access and publication settings determine visibility. People managing access can see the related names, email addresses, roles and invitation status; these administration records are not public. Published or shared content and its metadata are visible according to those settings. Anyone with an active share link may view its content until the link expires or is revoked. Gallery listings may appear in search results. Unlisted, expired and revoked links are intended to stay out of search results.
privacy.s5Body: TrackDraw uses providers for hosting, storage, authentication and email, including Cloudflare for infrastructure. They process information as needed to run and protect TrackDraw. Some operate outside the European Economic Area; where this applies, TrackDraw relies on standard contractual clauses or other approved transfer mechanisms under applicable data protection law. You can also authorize external apps to access or act on your account. Their access is limited by the permissions you grant and the operations TrackDraw supports. Review their access and privacy practices before connecting them. You can revoke access through your account controls, but this does not recall information an app has already received. Those apps handle received information under their own policies. Connecting an app does not automatically upload projects stored only on your device.
privacy.s6Body: TrackDraw uses functional cookies and browser storage for sign-in, preferences, local projects and editor state. It also uses an ephemeral analytics session identifier and session-scoped records to avoid duplicate events. These support the service and do not track you across sites. TrackDraw does not use analytics or marketing cookies.
privacy.s7Body: Local projects remain on your device until you remove them or clear browser storage. TrackDraw keeps hosted account, content and access records to provide the features you use and maintain ownership and permissions, with removal available where the product supports it. Minimal records needed to prevent duplicate requests may remain until account deletion, even after related content is removed. Accounts inactive for twelve months may be permanently removed with their hosted data after advance notices. Signing in or authenticated use restarts that period. Accounts that own a group are excluded from inactivity removal; group ownership must be resolved before account deletion. TrackDraw retains minimal records of account notices and removals for accountability. After account deletion, that record uses a random reference and does not retain the deleted name, email address or account ID. Expired and revoked shares are removed through routine cleanup. Individual analytics records are kept for limited periods; privacy-minimized summaries may be kept longer to understand trends. Security, operational and legal obligations may require some records to be kept longer.
privacy.s8Body: You can use core editing without an account. You can disable product analytics below without losing editing, import, export, sharing, gallery or read-only features. Anonymous analytics are limited to one browser session and is not later attached to an account. A signed-in objection applies across devices and removes raw analytics linked to your account, projects and shares. You can manage connected apps and credentials through your account controls. Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, export, restrict or object to the use of your information. In the Netherlands, you can complain to the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens.
privacy.s9Body: TrackDraw may update this policy when its use of information changes. Material changes will be reflected here before or when they take effect.
privacy.s10Body: For privacy questions or requests, email info@trackdraw.app. Please include "Privacy" in the subject so the message is easier to spot.

terms.metaDescription: Terms for using TrackDraw, managing your content, connecting external tools and relying on its outputs.
terms.effectiveDate: Effective October 21, 2026. These terms cover the hosted TrackDraw service, your content, connected tools and use of its outputs.
terms.s1Body: TrackDraw is a browser-based FPV race track design tool. Core editing is available without an account; hosted account features require sign-in. These terms apply to trackdraw.app and its hosted features.
terms.s2Body: Keep your account, sign-in methods, sessions and integration credentials secure. Only use accounts and access you are authorized to use, and do not expose credentials publicly. If you manage access for others, you are responsible for the invitations and permissions you grant. TrackDraw may limit or revoke access to protect the service, investigate abuse or meet legal obligations. Group ownership must be resolved before account deletion. Inactive accounts and hosted content may be permanently removed after advance notices, as described in the Privacy Policy. Removed accounts cannot be recovered.
terms.s3Body: Using TrackDraw does not transfer ownership of your content. You grant TrackDraw a limited license to host, process and deliver content as needed to provide the features you use. Only upload or share content you have the right to use. Do not expose private information without permission or submit unlawful, abusive, misleading or harmful content.
terms.s4Body1: Permissions and publication settings determine who can access content. Granting someone access does not make it public. Shared links and embeds provide read-only access; public listings and their metadata may be visible to visitors and search engines.
terms.s4Body2: Keep private venue details, personal information and sensitive notes out of public content. TrackDraw may restrict or remove shared content that is broken, abusive, unlawful or inconsistent with the service’s intended use.
terms.s5Body: You may connect external tools using the access methods TrackDraw provides. Authorize only tools you trust, review the permissions you grant and revoke access when it is no longer needed. A tool can act only within those permissions and the operations the service supports. You are responsible for activity you authorize and for reviewing resulting changes and outputs. External tools have their own terms and privacy practices. Do not use integrations to overload the service, bypass access controls, obtain other users’ private information or interfere with their work. TrackDraw may change, limit or revoke integration access for security, reliability, compatibility or abuse prevention.
terms.s6Body: Designs, recommendations, estimates, exports and other outputs are planning aids. Review them before relying on them, regardless of how they were created. You are responsible for checking actual material availability, the venue, race rules, safety requirements and the final build. Experimental outputs may need additional review and adjustment.
terms.s7Body: TrackDraw’s source code is available under the AGPL-3.0-only license. These terms cover the hosted service, which is separate from that source-code license. Hosted features depend on third-party services and may change, be limited, suspended or removed, or be offered under paid plans in the future. TrackDraw is provided as-is and may be interrupted by maintenance, infrastructure problems or provider outages.
terms.s8Body: TrackDraw does not promise that content, outputs or integrations will always be accurate, available or suitable for your needs. To the maximum extent allowed by applicable law, TrackDraw is not liable for indirect, incidental or consequential damages, loss of data, event disruption or safety issues arising from use of the service.
terms.s9Body: TrackDraw may update these terms when the service or legal requirements change. Continued use after changes means you accept the updated terms.
terms.s10Body: For questions about these Terms, email info@trackdraw.app. Please include "Terms" in the subject so the message is easier to spot.
